mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_daily_usage (user_id, quota_date, scope, limit_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{quotaDate}, #{scope}, #{limitCount}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, quota_date, scope) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, quota_date, scope, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, reasoning_tokens, total_tokens, limit_count, updated_at FROM ai_daily_usage WHERE quota_date = #{quotaDate} AND scope = #{scope} AND request_count > 0
